**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is considering getting a new bike rack for their car.  
[FACT] User has a hybrid bike.  
[FACT] User's car is a Toyota Corolla.  
[EVENT] User had to take their bike in for repairs in mid-February due to gear issues.  
[CHANGE] User is experiencing issues with their bike's gears, which were acting up and preventing proper shifting.  
[TEMPORAL] Session date is 2023/03/10 (Fri) 07:55.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants to carry just one bike.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for a bike rack that is easy to install and remove.  
[PREFERENCE] User is open to different price ranges but wants to know what they are getting for their money.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended several bike rack options based on user preferences, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Thule Evo 1-Bike Carrier (around $100-$150) - a popular, easy-to-install roof rack.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Yakima FullBack 1-Bike Carrier (around $150-$200) - a sleek, low-profile rack that is easy to install and remove.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Saris Bones 1-Bike Hitch Rack (around $150-$200) - a great option if the user has a hitch receiver on their Corolla.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kuat Transfer 1-Bike Hitch Rack (around $200-$250) - a high-end brand offering a premium hitch rack experience.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Thule Gateway 1-Bike Trunk Rack (around $80-$120) - a great trunk-mounted option that is easy to install and remove.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Yakima HangOut 1-Bike Trunk Rack (around $100-$150) - another trunk-mounted option that is easy to use.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided installation processes for both the Saris Bones and Kuat Transfer racks, detailing steps for assembly and installation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Saris Bones installation includes ensuring a hitch receiver is installed, assembling the rack, and securing it with bolts or pins.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kuat Transfer installation involves similar steps, with a focus on its more complex hitch adapter assembly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Both racks are considered "no-drill" installations and typically take around 30-60 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested consulting user manuals, watching installation videos, or seeking professional help if the user is unsure about installation.  
[PREFERENCE] User is leaning towards a hitch-mounted rack for ease of installation and removal.
